find: if (w >= 3 && h >= 3 && cells.length === w * h) return { mass: cells.length };
why: A mass is read off the bounding box alone, without the cell count: a hollow ring, a T or an L with both legs at least 3 cells reads as a mass, so the run-length block loses its Ls and the mass sizes include shapes that hold no interior cell.
